digest_binds: Preimage v1 is defined by acceptance._harness.auxsel: ASCII guildhall-auxiliary-pool-digest/1 plus NUL, then four blocks, each prefixed with its unsigned 8-byte big-endian byte length.

Block 1: explicit project() whitelist (FIELDS, CANDIDATE_FIELDS, COMPONENT_FIELDS, GENERATION_FIELDS and COMPONENTS); JSON sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(comma, colon), allow_nan=False; UTF-8, no newline; arrays retain manifest order.
Blocks 2-4: exact raw bytes of RIGHTS.md, GRANT-TEMPLATE.md, SELECTION-PROTOCOL.md, in that order. SHA-256 of the assembled preimage.

Ordered candidates bind paths, byte counts, digests, topics and versions; ordered generated components bind paths, kinds, seeds, digests and counts; the generation recipe is projected explicitly. --verify also checks actual files and regeneration.

Excluded: rights_basis, selectable, status, blocking, selection_record, pool_digest_sha256, digest_binds, superseded_pool_digests, GRANT.md, CC0-1.0.txt and any fields not explicitly projected. Grant and selection evidence are verified separately; changing their status cannot change the signed corpus identity.

algorithms.correlations: for i in range(96): join keys aux-key-<i:03d> and aux-key-<(i*7)%97:03d>; derived token is GHAUX-CHAIN- plus the first 20 uppercased hex characters of sha256('corr<i>')
algorithms.decoys: continuing the dictionaries generator stream: 160 GHAUXX-prefixed near misses, then 160 GHAUX- bodies one character short, then 192 bare 26-character bodies
algorithms.dictionaries: random.Random(seed); for each of 64 entries draw a 20-character body uniformly from [A-Z0-9], form GHAUX-<body>-e-acute, and emit the twelve frozen reversible forms of it
